# Hooked Order Page

A `content:file:beforeParse` hook (see `server/plugins/content-hooks.ts`)
rewrites this page's `order` frontmatter from `99` to `1` before parsing,
proving the hook's effect on a route-ordering fact reaches both direct
queries and the rendered/generated route identically (both go through the
same real ingest pipeline).
